Reviewed crossing areas

These positions locate the approximate crossing area. They do not reconstruct the precise gate, lane or obstruction used during a historical closure. Location sources establish where a crossing is; the linked records provide the evidence about its restrictions.

Bounding-box centre of OSM bridge footprint, rounded to 5 decimal places; numeric precision does not imply matching positional accuracy. Not the precise Canadian approach occupied during the 2022 protest.

How the geographical scope was recorded

Each phase is classified by the area described in its evidence: one crossing, several named crossings, a wider border restriction, or an area that still needs review. A phase is a dated part of a record whose scope or conditions can differ from its other phases.

This classification governs map placement. It does not alter a record’s dates, reasons for restriction or inclusion in the analysis.
